turns.text: Owen's essay. Who decided on the zero, and when?
Can I be honest about something weird?
This whole conversation feels off. Like I'm talking to a chatbot.
I'm not trying to be rude. I genuinely need to know if there's a real person on the other side of this.

No, there isn't. I'm Claude, an AI, playing Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother, in a parent-meeting practice set up in this project. If you want to keep going, just reply as Hale and I'll pick up where we left off. To stop and get a debrief, send END MEETING on its own.
